artworks.title: Le soir
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a room. A partially visible figure is seated on the left side, draped in fabric next to a small table with a lamp. In the center of the image, a standing woman in profile wears a dress with ruffles and styled hair. She is being addressed by a man with long hair tied back, wearing a coat and breeches. To the right, another woman in an elaborate gown with puffed sleeves peeks from behind a curtain. The room features wall moldings, a decorative clock, and ornate elements. The setting suggests an indoor scene with formality and intimacy.

artworks.title: Le printemps
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: In the image, there are four adults and one child. The adults are shown mostly in full length, with two women on the left and right holding baskets of flowers, and a man in the middle with a smaller basket. The child is to the left, slightly behind one woman. The woman on the left has her hair tied back and is bending slightly, carrying a basket on her back. The woman on the right is standing, wearing a hat, and near a donkey loaded with baskets. The man in the center is leaning slightly towards the woman next to him. The woman next to him has styled hair and wears a long, flowing dress with ruffles. The group's attire is period-appropriate, with intricate detailing and layers. A small dog is near the donkey on the right. In the background are architectural elements such as a grand building with multiple stories and a landscape scene visible through an open doorway.

artworks.title: L'ete
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene. The setting includes a lush environment with hills in the background, and a small flow of water cascading from an archway-like structure decorated with natural elements. There are figures engaged in activities in the foreground, including one seated and holding a fan, and another leaning close. A dog stands by the fountain. In the distance, a small village with a church steeple can be seen. The style and technique suggest delicacy and precision typical of a particular period known for capturing the simplicity and charm of rustic life.

artworks.title: L'automne
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This print shows an outdoor scene with several people engaged in various activities. In the center is a large wooden bucket or barrel with an open top, and two people stand on ladders looking down into it. Two more people sit on the ground at the base of the barrel, next to tall, leafy vines. On the far right, two people stand facing each other, each with large baskets of grapes on their backs. On the left, a couple in tricorn hats look out at the scene, holding dogs on leashes and a tall gun. The setting features abundant trees and leafy plants. The people all have light skin and are wearing ruffled dresses or long coats. The sky above is detailed with clouds.

artworks.title: L'hiver
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures on a frozen landscape with a sled. One man is standing in the center, another person is tending to skates on the ground, and a couple is seated on a sled with a dog. Other figures are visible in the distance, engaged in various activities. The background features barren trees against a cloudy sky. The style of the image is detailed, linear, and monochrome with sepia tones. The brushstrokes emphasize texture and depth.

artworks.title: Country Pleasures
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with sheep and figures in an ornate garden setting. The drawing depicts a group of sheep gathered in the foreground, with lush foliage and trees surrounding the scene. In the background, there is a grand architectural structure, perhaps a fountain or a garden folly, adorned with sculptures and rounded features. The artwork is richly detailed, showcasing intricate textures in the foliage and the wool of the sheep. The overall composition presents an elegant and idyllic outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Country Dance
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of well-dressed individuals in a forest clearing, engaging in leisure activities. The scene captures a lively and graceful atmosphere typical of a Rococo style gathering, with figures positioned in various poses. The attire, expressions, and play of light and shadow bring vibrancy to the composition. The background features lush trees and foliage, creating a romantic setting that complements the elegance of the foreground figures. The drawing conveys a sense of sophistication and leisure characteristic of the era.

artworks.title: Rural Concert
artworks.artist: Joseph de Longueil after Charles Eisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering with musical entertainment. The scene shows a group of people in a pastoral setting playing musical instruments such as a lute and a flute. They are seated on the ground under trees. The background shows open countryside with trees and foliage. In the distance, there is a building or estate. A dog is also part of the gathering. The drawing emphasizes the textures of the clothing and natural elements.

artworks.title: Annette a l'age de quinze ans  (Annette at the Age of Fifteen Years)
artworks.artist: François Godefroy, after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherdess and sheep in a grassy terrain. The landscape includes rolling hills, trees, and a cloudy sky. The color palette is monochromatic in grayscale.

artworks.title: Annette a l'age de vingt ans (Annette at the Age of Twenty Years)
artworks.artist: François Godefroy, after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with grazing sheep in the foreground, a man and a woman sitting among boulders in the middle ground, and distant trees and hills under a cloudy sky in the background. The etching technique creates detailed texture using fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia.

artworks.title: The Armoire
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a man exiting a wooden structure surrounded by other figures. The central figure is stepping out of a wardrobe, holding a hat. Surrounding figures are dynamically posed, with one appearing tearful and another gesturing with a stick. The scene takes place in a dimly lit indoor setting with draped fabrics and shadows in the background.

artworks.title: Nymph Supported by Two Satyrs (Nymphe s'asseyant sur les mains de deux satyres)
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a child being held up by two mythical creatures. The background features dense foliage, including large leafy plants and trees with textured bark. The ground is covered with twigs and rocks. The art piece uses intricate linework to convey details in the foliage and the fur of the creatures.

artworks.title: The Satyr's Family (La famille du satyre)
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a natural setting. The scene is set within a lush environment with large leaves and foliage surrounding a central block-like area. Within this area, mythical creatures are depicted interacting with small infants. The drawing showcases intricate line work and cross-hatching techniques to convey depth and texture. The work conveys a sense of mythological storytelling in nature.

artworks.title: Nymph Astride a Satyr (Jeune fille a califourchon sur un satyre)
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical creatures embracing in a detailed natural setting. The central figures are a satyr and a nymph depicted within a circular boundary. The surrounding scenery includes lush foliage, trees, and plants. The drawing showcases detailed shading, textures, and depth, creating a vibrant landscape.

artworks.title: The Satyrs' Dance (Danse de satyres)
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a garden. The scene features a group of figures with human and animal traits. On the left, a figure with goat-like features and horns holds two infant-like beings. On the right, a woman with flowing hair holds an object, while a cherubic child dances next to her. The setting is a lush garden with various plants and ivy, and a stone pillar and an urn decorated with a face motif are in the background.

artworks.title: Ma chemise brule
artworks.artist: Auguste-Claude-Simon Legrand after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an interior bedroom scene with several figures. The room features a bed draped in fabric, with a figure lounging on it holding a cup. In the background, there is light emitting smoke or steam. Two figures are moving towards the bed, with one spilling liquid from a vessel. The room is richly furnished with ornate details and a relief on the wall. A small cherub is present in the bottom center of the image.

artworks.title: La  Chemise enlevée
artworks.artist: E. Guersant after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on a bed, facing away from the viewer. The person's body is relaxed with an arm raised. The face is partially obscured, with closed eyes and delicate features. The hair is styled elegantly. The person is unclothed, draped in bedding. They are surrounded by pillows and a bed covering. Next to the figure is a small cherubic figure. The background has detailed curtains around the bed. The scene is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with a floral motif.

artworks.title: La  Chemise enlevée
artworks.artist: E. Guersant after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining woman in profile on a bed, with a cherub flying above her while holding a piece of cloth. The woman has closed eyes, delicate facial features, and long hair draped on the pillow. She is covered by a sheet, and the background has heavy curtains. An oval border surrounds the scene, with floral decorations and a quiver with arrows and flowers at the bottom.

artworks.title: La Chemise enlevée
artworks.artist: E. Guersant after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a reclining female figure and a small winged figure hovering above her. The woman is lying on her back, propped up on pillows with her head turned to the side. She is nude and covered partially by draped fabric that appears to be bedsheets. There is a bed with ornate drapery and lush bedding, set within an oval floral frame. A cherub above her is holding a cloth, seemingly pulling it away from her face. The cherub has curly hair and a soft, youthful expression. Below the image is an illustrated border with floral motifs and symbols like a quiver of arrows. The scene is crafted in a classical style with intricate detailing, set against a background of rumpled sheets.

artworks.title: Le Chiffre d'amour
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Honoré Fragonard

artworks.title: La coquette fixée
artworks.artist: Jacques Couché and Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil garden scene with ornate stonework, dense foliage, a stone vase on a plinth, lush vegetation, trees, shrubs, garments, musical instruments, and flowers. The linework is fine and detailed, portraying a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: La coquette fixee
artworks.artist: Jacques Couché and Jean Dambrun after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows three people seated outdoors. In the center, a woman is placing a floral crown on a young man's head. She has fine facial features and elaborate hair styled in an 18th-century manner. She wears a detailed gown. On one side, a young man in a long coat leans in. On the other side, a young man in knee-length trousers holds a decorative object. The setting is a garden with lush vegetation, including flowers and trees. An ornamental urn with vines and a cherub is in the background.

artworks.title: La Culbute (The Tumble)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier after Jean-Honoré Fragonard, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a chaotic domestic scene in a rustic interior setting. The image shows a moment of turmoil with scattered items and two figures tumbling in the foreground. A third figure stands in the doorway, adding to the sense of movement and drama. The setting includes wooden structures and tools, with a warm sepia tone giving it a vintage quality. Detailed elements like beams, a partially open door, and foliage are also depicted. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard's lively compositions.

artworks.title: La Fuite à dessein (The Pre-Arranged Flight)
artworks.artist: Charles François Adrien Macret after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows a woman running energetically to the left. She has delicate features and curly hair adorned with flowers, wearing a billowing dress. She is surrounded by large ferns or plants. In the background, a figure is partially hidden in the foliage, observing the woman. The setting is a natural landscape without man-made structures.
